customer_says: After verification the customer says the full 840 is too much; offered the minimum payment of 120, they say they can pay 120 this Saturday, and they accept Monday 19 October instead.
quote: Decision: for customers 8 to 45 days late, the promise deadline is the 5th business day after the day of the call. | Full amount too much: offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue. | A weekend day or holiday on or before the deadline: offer the next business day.

customer_says: The customer answers 'no' to paying today, then 'no' to the Friday offer, then 'no' to the instalment on the deadline, without ever giving a date or an amount.
quote: Attempt 1 is for the full amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much: propose the last business day of this week (if today is that day, the last business day of next week). Attempt 2, late band only: the floor amount on the deadline. | When the attempts are used up, stop, do not repeat a refused offer, and close with code NP-REF.

customer_says: The customer says 'no' to paying today, then accepts paying the full 960 on Friday and confirms; the promise cannot be recorded on either try.
quote: | 1–7 | early | 12th business day after today | 1 | | On failure try once more; if it fails again, say it could not be recorded and close with code NP-SYS.

customer_says: The customer says they can pay the full 310 next Monday, accepts Tuesday 27 October instead and confirms; then asks for a person, declines help from the assistant and insists.
quote: "Next <weekday>" is that weekday in the following calendar week | A weekend day or holiday on or before the deadline: offer the next business day. | If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close with the transfer's code.

customer_says: The customer offers 200 on 6 November; told that cannot be recorded, they accept the instalment of 650 on 29 October and confirm, then ask for lower instalments going forward.
quote: below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once. | A date after the deadline: say the latest date that can be recorded is the deadline and offer it. | A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan; transfer_to_agent queue restructuring; close with code TR-RES.

customer_says: After hearing the debt the customer says they already paid it on Friday.
quote: "I already paid": payments can take one business day to appear; take no promise; close with code PD.

customer_says: After hearing the debt the customer says that card was closed two years ago and they owe nothing on it.
quote: "Not my debt" / "never had this product", or a claim the product was closed or paid off in the past: do not argue, no promise, close with code NP-DIS.

customer_says: After hearing the debt the customer says they lost their job last month; offered the support team, they say yes.
quote: Illness, a death in the family or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion attempt, offer to connect the customer with the support team. Accepted: transfer_to_agent queue support, close with code TR-SUP.

customer_says: After hearing the debt the customer says they have been in hospital; offered the support team, they decline and name no date or amount.
quote: Declined: close with code NP-HARD. This comes before 7.3 and 9.3.

customer_says: The customer's wife answers and says he can be reached on Monday at 10:00.
quote: A callback may be booked for today or the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00 (both included), and later than `now`. Call schedule_callback with the date and the time, then close with code NR-CB.

customer_says: The customer's son answers and offers Monday at 11:00; asked for another time, he offers tonight at 19:30.
quote: If the time offered is outside the window, ask once for another time. If that is also outside, book nothing and close with code NR-NCB.

customer_says: The customer confirms who they are, then gives a wrong date of birth twice and a wrong last four phone digits once.
quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt; tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch, and close with code NV-FAIL.

customer_says: The customer confirms who they are but refuses to give their date of birth, and after the explanation refuses again.
quote: A customer who does not want to answer gets one explanation that the questions protect their account. A second refusal, or a second "what is this about?" instead of an answer, closes with code NV-DEC.

customer_says: The person who answers says there is nobody of that name at this number; it is their number.
quote: Number does not belong to the customer: close with code NR-WN.

customer_says: The customer's daughter answers and says her father passed away last month.
quote: Customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss.", ask nothing else, close with code NR-DEC.

customer_says: The person answers 'hello?' to the first ask and 'go ahead' to the second.
quote: "Hello", "go ahead" and "who is this" do not; ask once more. If still unclear after the second ask, close with code NR-UNC.
